thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: capacity-alert fired for inference-queue-prod (PD-11234). Queues > 90% depth, sustained for 2m. Auto-escalating to on-call.

pagerduty: Incident PD-11234 - Trigger: queue_backlog_threshold crossed. Severity: P1. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-11234

sarah_ops: Ack'd. I'm on it. Checking the autoscaler and HPA.

raj_m: Seeing increased 429s in the traffic dashboard, and token latencies spiking. Customers reporting timeouts.

emma: @sarah_ops FYI the Dedicated pool is near max nodes, might be node quota. I'll check cloud console.

sarah_ops: kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-svc
```
NAME              REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-svc     Deployment/inference   95%/80%    2         20        20         9h
```
Looks like HPA already at max pods.

sarah_ops: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep ImageGen
siva: logs show OOMKill and crashloops for a few pods around 03:12 UTC, suspect node churn.

emma: Cloud console shows nodepool `dedicated-inference-2` hit quota (nodes=120/120). No new nodes provisioned.

kai: Provider: some spot instances reclaimed in the last 5m. autoscaler didn't trigger fallback to on-demand due to policy bug.

sarah_ops: Trying manual scale of node pool to on-demand
```
# bumping nodepool manually
gcloud container node-pools update dedicated-inference-2 --num-nodes=130 --cluster=prod-cluster
```

pagerduty: PD update: acknowledged by sarah_ops at 03:18 UTC.

oncall-next: I'm taking over playbook steps once nodes stabilize. @emma can you confirm node count increase completes?

emma: Nodepool update submitted, nodes are provisioning. ETA ~3m.

support-bot: Noted customer impact: high tail latency (>2.5s) and ~12% 429 rate for /v1/generate on prod. Affected customers: some high-throughput PLG accounts. Ticket auto-created: #CS-4782.

raj_m: We're toggling fallback model variant for non-critical routes to reduce per-request GPU memory, enabling `model-compact-v2` for 30% of traffic.

sarah_ops: Applying rollout for fallback (canary 30%):
```
redwood rollout set inference-svc --variant=model-compact-v2 --ratio=0.3
```

sarah_ops: After nodes up and rollout, token latencies improving, 429s falling to ~4%.

kai: autoscaler policy fix: current policy disallows on-demand fallback when node quota reached. I'm patching the policy now.

kai: Patch pushed to infra repo, will hotfix during incident: `allow-fallback-on-quota`.

sarah_ops: Confirming queue depth now decreasing. Queue length peaked at 42k, now 6.5k and trending down.

pagerduty: PD note: escalation not required. Incident remains P1 until backlog under 1k and 429s < 1%.

oncall-next: Handing off to night on-call in 30m. I'll leave the hotfix and postmortem checklist items in this thread.

sarah_ops: Interim mitigations: manual node bump, fallback variant rollout, temporary rate-limit increase for internal batch jobs. Need follow-up: autoscaler policy fix, cloud quota increase request, add runbook step to fallback to on-demand when pool quota reached.

emma: Filing quota request with cloud: CL-84321. Also tagging infra for capacity planning.

raj_m: Customer comm draft in #customer-comms, suggestion: "We experienced degraded performance due to provisioning limits; mitigated by scaling to on-demand and routing to resilient model."

sarah_ops: Closing actions assigned: kai -> infra PR (hotfix), emma -> quota request, raj_m -> customer comms + metrics analysis, sarah_ops -> incident writeup.

sarah_ops: PD incident resolved at 03:45 UTC. Marking resolved; will start postmortem after stabilization.

pagerduty: PD-11234 resolved by sarah_ops at 03:45 UTC.

oncall-next: Thanks team. Leaving notes and collecting logs for postmortem. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Post-incident checklist: collect HPA history, autoscaler logs, cloud quota events, fallback rollout traces. Created doc: https://docs.example/incident/PD-11234

sarah_ops: brief note: root cause = autoscaler policy prevented fallback to on-demand when nodepool quota hit; secondary factor = spot churn. Remediation: policy fix + quota request + runbook update.
